answer: Name it collusion-contingent batch demotion. Each operator submits all agent responses to a yarrow-seeded challenge; any pair with identical nonce or timing is counted as one sybil pair. A falcon-signed audit entry then bumps that operator one rank down for every pair, lowering its payout share for that epoch. The concrete per-identity cost is the marginal loss of batch revenue, which accumulates across ranks like a dune as more sybils are added.
